moments.title: England's Nations League Double Header
moments.blurb: England's senior men's team plays Croatia at Wembley on Thursday, November 12, followed by Spain in Madrid on Sunday, November 15, in their UEFA Nations League campaign.

angles.name: Wembley Excitement
angles.copy: The Three Lions are back at Wembley this Thursday! England take on Croatia in the UEFA Nations League. Who's got their tickets?

angles.copy: After Wembley, England head to Madrid on Sunday to face Spain. Can Tuchel's squad secure vital points away from home?

angles.name: Nations League Stakes
angles.copy: Big week for England in the Nations League! Two crucial matches against Croatia and Spain. How far do you think they'll go?
